Test Case 3: GET /v2/impulses - List Impulses with Pagination

Input:
  endpoint: GET /v2/impulses?project_id=project-impulse-list&limit=3&offset=0
  headers: { Authorization: Bearer {token} }

Expected Output:
  status: 200
  response: {
    impulses: array (length <= 3),
    total: number,
    limit: 3,
    offset: 0
  }
  paginationEnforced: true
